headline: Friday in Branson: Cooler Skies & The Trail of Lights Opens
lede: Friday, November 6 brings much cooler highs in the mid-50s with mostly sunny skies and a chance of patchy drizzle in the morning — perfect weather to kick off the holiday season as the Trail of Lights at Shepherd of the Hills debuts at dusk.

featured.title: Trail of Lights Opening Night
featured.why: The beloved drive-through holiday light display returns for the season. A magical first-timer experience with thousands of lights and festive music. Confirm current hours and ticket details locally.

plan.title: Matinee Show
plan.detail: Catch a morning performance like The Sound of Simon & Garfunkel or Absolutely Country, Definitely Gospel. Many theaters open by 10 AM.

plan.title: Branson Landing or Strip
plan.detail: Explore the waterfront or drive the strip for holiday decorations and early dinner. Mild temps make outdoor walking comfortable.

plan.title: Trail of Lights
plan.detail: Head to Shepherd of the Hills for the opening night of the drive-through light display. A highlight for families and couples.

indoor.name: Legends in Concert
indoor.detail: World-class celebrity tributes in a climate-controlled theater. Great for a cool November evening.

indoor.name: Clay Cooper Theatre
indoor.detail: High-energy country and holiday shows. Family-friendly and warm.

indoor.name: Americana Theatre
indoor.detail: Gospel, magic, and variety performances throughout the day.
